name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka’s motorsport journey began with a childhood fascination for engineering and a deep-seated passion for speed. After graduating with honors in mechanical engineering from the University of Tokyo, he joined Toyota as a junior engineer, quickly rising through the ranks due to his meticulous approach and problem-solving skills. His knack for optimizing performance within complex systems caught the attention of senior management, leading to his appointment as team principal for Toyota Gazoo Racing BR.

Kenji believes in fostering a collaborative environment where data-driven decisions are paramount. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to extract maximum performance from both his team and the machinery. His pragmatic approach, combined with a relentless pursuit of perfection, makes him a formidable leader within the competitive world of motorsport. He is driven to push the boundaries of innovation to take Toyota Gazoo Racing BR to the top.
